pr_title: kernel: need to release spinlock before busy_wait
pr_body:
need to release spinlock first before busy_wait,
or other cores cannot get the spinlock when the holder is
busy waitting.

Fixes #20045

Signed-off-by: Wayne Ren <wei.ren@synopsys.com>
pr_comments: Oh, and do you have a test case that caught this latency problem?  IIRC, when I added it I went with the simple busy wait because I couldn't actually get the spin to happen.  The IPI on qemu, at least, seems to happen almost synchronously and I couldn't catch it before it completed.

> Oh, and do you have a test case that caught this latency problem? IIRC, when I added it I went with the simple busy wait because I couldn't actually get the spin to happen. The IPI on qemu, at least, seems to happen almost synchronously and I couldn't catch it before it completed.

I found this in debugging of ARC HSDK which has 4 cores, using tests/kernel/smp
